description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, styling, and the main App component, then renders the App within a DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root DOM node for rendering the React application.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM under the root.
